components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A rare amber action used only to advance a phase.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height:44px; padding:12px 16px; border:1px solid #D9A05B; border-radius:0; background:#D9A05B; color:#0F1114; font:500 15px sans-serif; transition:background 180ms ease-out,color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-primary:hover,.ds-primary:focus-visible { background:#E9C79B; outline:2px solid #D9A05B; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-primary:active { background:#C58B4C; }

components.name: Choice Row
components.description: A full-width numbered decision with clear keyboard parity.
components.css: .ds-choice { width:100%; min-height:44px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:24px auto 1fr; gap:10px; align-items:center; padding:10px 14px; border:1px solid #262B31; border-radius:0; background:#15181C; color:#C9D1D9; text-align:left; font:400 15px sans-serif; transition:background 180ms ease-out,border-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-choice span { color:#D9A05B; } .ds-choice small { color:#7B838C; justify-self:end; } .ds-choice:hover,.ds-choice:focus-visible { background:#1C2126; border-color:#D9A05B; outline:none; } .ds-choice:active { background:#242930; }

components.name: Observer Input
components.description: A secondary free-text channel that never impersonates executable choices.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="对它说话……自由文本不产生控制权限" />
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; height:40px; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid #262B31; border-radius:0; background:#0F1114; color:#C9D1D9; font:400 14px sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#89919B; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:#D9A05B; outline:1px solid #D9A05B; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Status Strip
components.description: Compact world-state facts with a textual danger cue.
components.css: .ds-status { display:flex; gap:16px; align-items:center; color:#7B838C; font:400 13px sans-serif; } .ds-status span+span::before,.ds-status strong::before { content:'｜'; margin-right:16px; color:#262B31; } .ds-status strong { color:#B8433A; font-weight:500; }

components.name: Observation Log
components.description: A flat evidence stream with stable speaker prefixes.
components.html:
世界｜电池箱已经打开。

它｜我会记住你做了什么。

依据：M碮信念 M-004
components.css: .ds-log { padding:16px; border:1px solid #262B31; border-radius:0; background:#0F1114; color:#C9D1D9; font:400 15px/1.5 sans-serif; } .ds-log p { margin:0 0 8px; } .ds-log b { font-weight:500; } .ds-log .agent { color:#D9A05B; } .ds-log .meta { color:#7B838C; font-size:13px; }

narrative.overview: 界面是一间安静但正在工作的观察室。左侧空间呈现人工生命与环境变化，右侧控制台只呈现此刻需要理解的事实、历史和选择。系统克制、临床、有人性，并明确拒绝霓虹赛博朋克、紫蓝渐变、泛滥故障特效和程序员控制台式信息倾倒。
keyCharacteristics: 稀少而有意义的琥珀信号
世界事实与表达明确分离
关系通过空间声音和措辞呈现

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: 琥珀色只表示现在值得注意，禁止把它当装饰铺满界面。

rules.name: The Evidence Voice Rule
rules.body: 世界、它、系统必须稳定使用各自前缀，不能靠颜色单独区分来源。

rules.name: The Flat Chamber Rule
rules.body: 静止界面保持平面；只有交互焦点和危险状态可以短暂抬升视觉优先级。

dos: Do 在三种目标分辨率验证所有交互控件。
Do 为关键选择提供鼠标与键盘等价路径。
Do 让结局只引用仍然存在的事件 ID。
donts: Don't 做霓虹赛博朋克、紫蓝渐变或泛滥故障特效。
Don't 做程序员控制台式信息倾倒。
Don't 让大模型台词替代世界事实或可执行行为。
